description: This file is a shell script that performs unit tests on the 'test-tool' utility, specifically testing submodule activation detection functions. It sets up git repositories with submodules, manipulates configuration settings, and verifies behavior of the 'submodule is-active' command under various scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands for after test execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates an initial commit in a given git directory.
